number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits unless stated) with the nearest binary64. 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational.
method: nondimensional pencils (L = 1, EI = 1, mbar = 1; rods EA = 1). Omega^2 = omega^2 mbar L^4/EI (beams), omega^2 mbar L^2/EA (rods). rel_freq_error = sqrt(Omega^2_FE)/Omega_continuum - 1. observed_order = log2(|err_N/err_2N|) (null where the two errors differ in sign).

expected.lumped_beam_control: frequency error not bounded, negative here; observed order about 4 for this simply supported span (O(h^2) in general)

elements.scaling: K_ij = EI/h^3 * Khat_ij * h^(p_i+p_j); M_ij = mbar h * Mhat_ij * h^(p_i+p_j); R_ij = ibar/h * Rhat_ij * h^(p_i+p_j); p = (0,1,0,1)

lumped_control.mass: translational nodal lumps mbar h/2 per element end; no rotational mass (M singular)

rods.closed_form: Omega_j^2 = 6 N^2 (1 - cos t_j)/(2 + cos t_j), t_j = (2j-1) pi/(2N) (cantilever) or j pi/N (fixed-fixed)
Omega_j^2 = 6 N^2 (1 - cos t_j)/(2 + cos t_j), t_j = (2j-1) pi/(2N) (cantilever) or j pi/N (fixed-fixed)

coarse_discretization.definition: Uniform mesh of N Euler-Bernoulli consistent-mass elements on span L. f_e = first fixed-fixed frequency of one element alone (length L/N); f_n = continuum frequency of mode n. fe_over_fn = (4.7300407... N/(beta_n L))^2. A later slice derives c so that fe_over_fn >= c bounds the error; summary gives the largest error among rows with fe_over_fn >= c. Rows: N = 1..16, modes 1..min(6, dofs).
